scope: Calibrated telemetry reference only; NOT visual feedback acceptance. Ground truth is used as sensor in this reference.

baseline_lock.source_scope: procedural queue simulator; development ground truth for baseline selection only

summary.status: computed; acceptance requires detector and performance gates
summary.aggregation: meanWait weighted by entered vehicles; meanQueue and throughput weighted by measurement duration; paired difference and bootstrap are unweighted pair differences
summary.confidence_interval_method: paired nonparametric bootstrap; pairs resampled; 5000 replicates by default

scope_notes: all p95 directions and each pair reported; zero baseline uses absolute difference
